notes.title: Spectrum Siege is HERE! – Conquer, Strategize, and Dominate!
notes.content:
🔥 Spectrum Siege is LIVE! 🔥

The wait is over! Get ready to test your strategic mind in Spectrum Siege, a fresh take on turn-based strategy where every move can shift the entire battlefield. Whether you're a tactical mastermind or a casual strategist, this game will challenge you in new ways!

🕹 Key Features:
✅ Unique Grid-Based Gameplay – Control a color, jump over opponents, and claim territory in a dynamic  grid.
✅ Dynamic Turn-Based Strategy – Every move flips the board—think ahead or be overrun!
✅ Challenging NPC Opponents – Battle against smart NPC that adapts to your tactics.
✅ Multiplayer Mode – Compete with friends or players localy!
✅ Stylish & Minimalist Visuals – Clean, intuitive design that keeps the focus on strategy.
✅ Multiple Game Modes – Classic, Timed, and/or Events and more modes to suit your playstyle.

🏆 Will You Outmaneuver Your Rivals?
Jump in NOW and prove your dominance on the grid! 🚀
